issues.description: Function parameter order mismatch for correct_teleportation: the problem statement and template define correct_teleportation(teleportation_measurements, x_measurements) (teleportation measurements first, X-basis measurements second). The solution implements the same signature but calls the function with the arguments reversed in multiple places (passing X-basis/destructive measurements first and teleportation measurements second). This inconsistency between the intended API and its usage in simulate_msd_one_round and simulate_msd_two_rounds will produce incorrect behavior and is confusing for students trying to follow the specified contract.
issues.suggestedFix: Make usage match the documented signature. In simulate_msd_one_round and simulate_msd_two_rounds, pass teleportation measurements as the first argument and X-basis/destructive measurements as the second argument when calling correct_teleportation. For example change calls of the form correct_teleportation(measurements[:, final], measurements[:, tele]) to correct_teleportation(measurements[:, tele], measurements[:, final]). Alternatively, if the reversed order was intentional, update the function signature and documentation in the problem statement and template to reflect the actual parameter order.
